patronOf.en-US: Pope and keeper of the martyrs' tombs
patronOf.pt-BR: Papa e guardião dos túmulos dos mártires

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant, we pray, O Lord, that we may constantly exalt the merits of your Martyrs.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos, Senhor, permanecer fiéis ao culto dos vossos mártires.

meta.face: A Roman of Spanish stock, about seventy-five, with a broad-browed, RECTANGULAR face — a wide, flat forehead, a long straight nose with a broad bridge, large, wide-set dark eyes under level, heavy grey brows, flat broad cheekbones, a strong, square jaw and a firm, straight mouth; short grey hair showing under the cap at the temples; a short, ROUNDED grey-and-white beard trimmed close to the jaw, with a grey moustache; a calm, watchful gaze looking out a little to the side. Not a flowing white-bearded patriarch: the beard is short and round.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the Lund Gospels miniature (c. 1150) we checked shows him with short grey hair, a short rounded grey beard, a long nose and wide-set eyes, in a red chasuble and a pallium with small crosses under a low white cap. The card keeps those marks and sets him in San Callisto, among the martyrs' tombs he honoured with his inscriptions.
